messages:
Sam (CS): Morning — CedarBay private VPC cutover day 2. Customer saw bursty 502s to internal object store during backup window (02:10 UTC). They flagged predictable latency as a renewal concern. Opening CS-9982.

Lina (DevOps): Quick triage: ELB/NATGW show retransmit spikes at 02:12. Suspect PMTU/MSS and a KMS rotation at 02:15. Asking CedarNetOps for tunnel MTU and backup exact start time.

CedarNetOps: Tunnel MTU is 1500; backups start 02:10. We can test MSS clamp to 1400 tonight.

Raj (SecEng): KMS note: rotation scheduled 02:15 — backups reading right after will cause decrypt bursts. Options: move rotation to 03:00, stagger backup role, or add short decrypt cache. Also they requested decrypt audit exports to their audit account; will draft IAM snippet.

Sam (CS): Actions: 1) @Lina attach ELB graphs + small pcap to CS-9982; 2) @Raj add KMS policy snippet + FAQ; 3) @CedarNetOps test MSS clamp tonight and upload traces. If not stable in 48h, escalate to AM for renewal mitigation.

Lina (DevOps): Uploaded graphs + 20s pcap to CS-9982. Evidence of PMTU blackhole when packet size >1400. Recommend MSS clamp and rerun.

CedarNetOps: MSS clamp applied for test window; will run curl + tcpdump at 02:10 and post results.

Raj (SecEng): Drafted KMS FAQ blurb in ticket: "Avoid synchronous backup reads during rotations; recommended to schedule rotations after backups or use a warm-cache." IAM snippet placeholder added.

OnboardBot: Ticket CS-9982 updated — assignees: Lina, Raj, CedarNetOps. Status: investigation. Next update requested in 8h.

Sam (CS): Captured customer feedback: they want a one-page network+KMS checklist and explicit note about rotation/backups in onboarding docs. Flagged renewal_risk. Please keep short customer-facing updates in CS-9982.
